## Summary
Implement the core item generation step (Sonnet) and critique gate that evaluates generated items against NBME quality standards, retrying up to 2 times if the item fails critique.

## User story
As a pipeline step, I need to generate NBME-quality stems with correct answers and validate them through a critique gate, so that only clinically accurate, well-formed items proceed to distractor generation.

## Why this matters
This is the most expensive and quality-critical step in the pipeline. Sonnet generates the stem, lead-in, and correct answer. The critique gate catches clinical inaccuracies, poor stem construction, and NBME format violations before distractors are added. Without the critique gate, ~15-20% of items would be clinically flawed or structurally invalid, wasting downstream processing costs and faculty review time.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Core generation uses SONNET_MODEL with NBME system prompt
- [ ] Each item generates: stem (clinical vignette), lead-in question, correct answer (key), Bloom level tag
- [ ] System prompt loaded from packages/ai/prompts/nbme-system.md via loadPrompt (AP-12)
- [ ] Critique gate evaluates against: clinical accuracy, stem clarity, single-best-answer, Bloom alignment, NBME format
- [ ] Critique prompt loaded from packages/ai/prompts/critique-gate.md via loadPrompt
- [ ] Max 2 critique retries -- items failing after 2 retries marked `critique_failed`
- [ ] Critique feedback fed back into generation prompt on retry
- [ ] All Claude responses parsed with safeJsonParse (Rule 2)
- [ ] Batch items processed with Promise.allSettled (Rule 3)
- [ ] All context sanitized with sanitizeForContext + buildContextBlock (Rule 5)
- [ ] Cost per item does not exceed $0.027 (max 3 Sonnet calls)
- [ ] Output shape: `{ stem, leadIn, key, bloomLevel, critiqueScore, critiqueNotes }`

## Canonical decisions in play

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// apps/inngest/functions/p3-steps/generate-core.ts
import { safeJsonParse } from '@journey/ai/safe-parse';
import { SONNET_MODEL } from '@journey/ai/constants';
import { sanitizeForContext, buildContextBlock } from '@journey/ai/sanitize';
import { loadPrompt } from '@journey/ai/prompts';

const MAX_CRITIQUE_RETRIES = 2;

export async function generateCore(
  contextWindow: string,
  ecdOutput: ECDOutput,
  itemCount: number
): Promise<GeneratedItem[]> {
  const systemPrompt = await loadPrompt('nbme-system');
  const critiquePrompt = await loadPrompt('critique-gate');

  // Generate all items in parallel with Promise.allSettled
  const results = await Promise.allSettled(
    Array.from({ length: itemCount }, (_, i) =>
      generateAndCritique(systemPrompt, critiquePrompt, contextWindow, ecdOutput, i)
    )
  );

  return results
    .filter((r): r is PromiseFulfilledResult<GeneratedItem> => r.status === 'fulfilled')
    .map(r => r.value);
}

async function generateAndCritique(
  systemPrompt: string,
  critiquePrompt: string,
  context: string,
  ecdOutput: ECDOutput,
  index: number
): Promise<GeneratedItem> {
  let attempt = 0;
  let item: GeneratedItem;
  let critiquePassed = false;

  while (attempt <= MAX_CRITIQUE_RETRIES && !critiquePassed) {
    // Generate
    const genResponse = await callClaude(SONNET_MODEL, systemPrompt, context);
    const { data: generated } = safeJsonParse<RawItem>(genResponse);

    // Critique
    const critiqueResponse = await callClaude(SONNET_MODEL, critiquePrompt, JSON.stringify(generated));
    const { data: critique } = safeJsonParse<CritiqueResult>(critiqueResponse);

    if (critique.passed) {
      critiquePassed = true;
      item = { ...generated, critiqueScore: critique.score, critiqueNotes: critique.notes };
    } else {
      // Feed critique back on retry
      context = buildContextBlock('critique_feedback', critique.feedback);
      attempt++;
    }
  }

  if (!critiquePassed) {
    return { ...item!, status: 'critique_failed' };
  }
  return item!;
}
```
